messages:
Priya (Product): Heads-up — three enterprise accounts requested stricter retention SLAs and a BYOK handoff guarantee. Can we scope this for the next compliance sprint?
Asha (CSE): Customers: AcmeHealth (HIPAA), FinLedger, and GlobalERP. All asked for a contract clause and evidence export by end of month.
Mateo (Eng): Do we have target retention SLOs? 30/90/365 days? Need to know index/search SLA too.
Sofia (Security): Important: BYOK escrow handoff + proof of zero-access logs. We'll need KMS policy changes, key-wrap proof artifacts, and SOC2 evidence. :lock:
Jonas (SRE): Storage cost note — hot-searchable logs for 365d will spike costs. Can we do tiered retention: 30d hot, 336d cold archive with export on request?
Li (Legal): Contract language: need clear SLAs, data egress windows, and legal hold clauses. We should avoid "guaranteed access" language without ops runway.
Priya (Product): Proposal: acceptance gates = (1) retention config UI + RBAC, (2) BYOK handshake + escrow playbook, (3) audit-log export + signed manifest, (4) cost model + tiering doc.
Mateo (Eng): Implementation notes — can leverage existing export job, add manifest signing. Pseudoconfig:
```
retention:
  hot_days: 30
  archive_days: 365
  export_on_hold: true
```
Sofia (Security): Need to add: signed audit manifest with key fingerprint and HSM attestation step.
Asha (CSE): If we commit, I'll sync customers and negotiate dates. They prefer canary rollout per-tenant. :+1:
Priya (Product): Ok — next steps: eng/security to estimate story points by EOD Wednesday, legal to draft contract language, CS to align customers. I'll add to sprint planning board.
Mateo (Eng): On it — will post estimates and a rough tech design thread.
Sofia (Security): Will schedule a 30m sync for KMS escrow details.
